newsitem.title: USA: UAL's United Air in pact with machinists.
newsitem.headline: UAL's United Air in pact with machinists.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said Friday it had reached a tentative agreement with the International Association of Machinists on wages.
The pact increases wages by three percent in both 1997 and 1998, and by two percent in both 1999 and 2000, United said.
Also, the machininsts are eligible for lump-sum profit-sharing payments of up to two percent in 1998 and 1999, depending on the company's performance in 1997 and 1998, respectively, the airline said.
The pact represents a mid-term wage adjustment, a process designed to ensure the wages of United employees keep pace with the rest of the industry, United said.
IAM-represented employees will vote on the tentative agreement during the week of January 6, United said.
